```{r}
#| echo = false
data.nutriment <- read_excel("data_lake.xlsx", 
                             sheet = "nutriments",
                             range = "A3:J98", 
                             col_names = FALSE)
data.biotic    <- read_excel("data_lake.xlsx", sheet = "biotic")

names(data.nutriment) <- c("year", "area",
                           "P_municipal", "P_industrial", "P_other",
                           "N_municipal", "N_industrial", "N_other",
                           "BOD_municipal", "BOD_industrial")
names(data.biotic)[1:6] <- c("year", "sub_basin", "area",
                             "phyto_richness", "prim_prod", "fish_catch")

```
